txt: WHEN a fan-out helper splits into GOMAXPROCS workers with only an on/off work gate, the that helper SHALL scale the WORKER COUNT to the work as well, one worker per fixed grain of element-work capped by GOMAXPROCS, and pick the grain against both the clock and the CPU.

WHEN a decode primitive declares a local fixed-size byte array and hands a slice of it to a call that takes an interface, the that primitive SHALL hang the buffer on the receiver instead, because the slice escapes and the array is heap-allocated on every invocation.
WHEN reporting a change that removes per-call allocations, the report SHALL state the allocation delta and the clock delta separately, because they routinely disagree by an order of magnitude.

ti: Open quantized GGUF files through retained read-only mappings

note: Correctness: ownership is explicit; no finalizer; Close invalidates mapped tensor views by documented contract and is idempotent. Malformed mapped input must release before returning. Scope: new API plus a shared parsed-to-raw constructor; existing ReadRaw and eager ReadFile remain unchanged. Performance: buffered control and mapped candidate coexist in one candidate binary, with fresh-process order alternation on the pinned 638 MiB TinyLlama file; the gate covers latency, heap bytes, and allocations. Verification: exact metadata/type/shape/byte parity, capacity clamps, hostile/truncated input, fallback behavior, race, CGO-disabled suite, and non-Unix cross-compiles. No prior rejection addresses retained raw-file mappings; the returned unrelated kernel rejections do not constrain this proposal.
Authorized by the standing M2-first performance goal and the user instruction to continue autonomously. The proposal passed correctness, scope, performance, and verification review.

body: Implement an ARM64-only fused Q4_K M1 row-dot kernel, select it through dotQ4KRowFn, keep portable and all M>1 behavior unchanged, add direct scalar-reference and QMatMul numerical coverage, and retain only if repeated Apple M2 leaf and N=4096/K=1024 measurements show a material speedup with no allocation regression. note: Reopened solely to revise the declared impact targets; measured implementation outcome remains accepted.
Reactivated after widening the declared kernel, evidence, documentation, and spec targets.

Implemented ARM64 Q4_K fused NEON unpack-affine-dot dispatch with zero leaf allocations and explicit 1e-4 scalar-relative tolerance coverage. M2 n=10 after first-sample removal: K4096 leaf 4792.0 to 599.2 ns (8.00x), M1 N64 K1024 75.524 to 9.726 us (7.77x), M1 N4096 K1024 689.5 to 145.9 us (4.73x), recurrent Mamba2 Q4_K 349.2 to 118.8 us (2.94x); Q6_K negative control flat. Materialize-then-dot rejected because it regressed and allocated. Evidence is internal/benchcompare/leadership/evidence/m2-arm64-q4k-fused-dot-20260821; generalizable detector filed as perfscan #799. Local preflight, race, vet, CGO0, and ARM64/amd64 cross-compiles pass; long TestDiffusionLMGrammarE2E fails identically on base and candidate.

Merged in PR #1132 at 89795e4a after all 15 CI lanes passed. The retained ARM64 Q4_K fused dot delivered 4.73x at the largest measured production QMatMul shape and 2.94x in Mamba2 while preserving all non-ARM64 and M>1 routes. Generalizable fast-path bypass risk was reported as perfscan issue #799. The Q6_K negative control was statistically flat and is intentionally left for a separate measured proposal.
